class.name: StaticBody3D
class.brief_description: A 3D physics body that can't be moved by external forces. When moved manually, it doesn't affect other bodies in its path.
class.description: A static 3D physics body. It can't be moved by external forces or contacts, but can be moved manually by other means such as code, [AnimationMixer]s (with [member AnimationMixer.callback_mode_process] set to [constant AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS]), and [RemoteTransform3D]. When [StaticBody3D] is moved, it is teleported to its new position without affecting other physics bodies in its path. If this is not desired, use [AnimatableBody3D] instead. [StaticBody3D] is useful for completely static objects like floors and walls, as well as moving surfaces like conveyor belts and circular revolving platforms (by using [member constant_linear_velocity] and [member constant_angular_velocity]).

members.member: The body's constant angular velocity. This does not rotate the body, but affects touching bodies, as if it were rotating.
The body's constant linear velocity. This does not move the body, but affects touching bodies, as if it were moving.

The maximum penetration depth (in meters) for a contact to be considered shallow enough to filter as a ghost collision. Contacts deeper than this value are always kept. Only used when [member ghost_collision_filtering_enabled] is [code]true[/code].

If [code]true[/code], enables ghost collision filtering for dynamic bodies contacting this static body. Shallow contacts are filtered based on [member ghost_collision_threshold_angle] and [member ghost_collision_depth_threshold] to prevent false collisions when bodies graze this surface at shallow angles.

The angle threshold (in radians) used to determine ghost collisions. Shallow contacts whose normal aligns with the up direction beyond this angle are filtered out. Only used when [member ghost_collision_filtering_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. Defaults to 45 degrees.
The physics material override for the body. If a material is assigned to this property, it will be used instead of any other physics material, such as an inherited one.
